description.narrative: This activity PROCOFSERVICES for Eco Systems and Poverty Research Programme is a component of ESPA - Eco System Services for Poverty Alleviation reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £25,639,644. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Environmental research, Water resources conservation (including data collection).
